global_invariants: Authorize and filter before Species/Form existence, body details, variants, hidden forms, weaknesses, counts, compare targets, compatibility warnings, provenance, exports, diagnostics, notifications or AI context.
The verified 13-layer Species/Form/Biology identity-state model remains explicit from reusable Definition through Character/runtime state, visibility and provenance/recovery.
Culture, society, belief, profession, learned behavior, equipment, temporary Effects/Conditions and Campaign environment never become immutable biology without explicit source/rule evidence.

Species eligibility, dataset membership, tree adjacency, same-name records, shared documents, tier, order, visual similarity and narrative similarity cannot establish biology ownership, lineage, Form identity, compatibility or exact mechanics.
The governed 2,203-row mixed Species/Elementalist/Innate Ability surface remains 260 Species Perks, 539 Innate Abilities and 1,404 Elementalist rows with no automatic biology promotion.
The 60 detailed and 57 pricing-only Shapeshifter rows remain separate review surfaces with zero automatic merges by name, tier, position, order or similarity.

Unknown/source-unspecified anatomy, physiology, lifespan, breathing, movement, compatibility, limitation or Adaptation state remains unknown; no human default or universal compatibility is synthesized.

Accepted Species/Form selection, correction, current-form change, transformation, Adaptation, Ability, bioengineering and reveal mutations are server-authoritative, expected-version checked and recoverable through operation ID/status and idempotency.
Reusable Species/Form Definitions and raw PDF/CSV source never change as a side effect of Character/runtime mutation.
Every workflow has keyboard, touch, high-zoom/reflow and screen-reader-equivalent operation; color, silhouette, body-diagram pointing, drag, hover and animation are never required.

No implementation of full PPIA-06 appearance, PPIA-08 environment authoring, PPIA-11 balance calibration or PPIA-12 world/culture authoring here.
No application runtime implementation, STAGE-A-A2 activation, release, deployment, tester access, paid service or production credential authority.
